The '''''Trait Luminique''''' was a prototype [[Starship/Legends|starship]] built by the corporation [[Flight Unlimited Group]] in their [[Flight Unlimited Group base|base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lankor VI]]. It possessed incredible energy boosters and a powerful [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]].<ref name="Le facteur X" />
